benchmark.name: ClaimBench
benchmark.instruction: Judge only from the supplied 10-K excerpt, not external company knowledge.
benchmark.excerpt_lengths: Short paragraph; medium about2k–4k tokens; long about8k–16k tokens.

targets.interpretation: Overall100% is already tied by four frontier language models. A new100% row ties their accuracy; decision-model track and cost/latency tradeoffs must be stated separately. One fewer error is only0.051percentagepoints; statistical superiority is not established by a one-item point advantage.

calibration_and_cost.threshold_rule: Lowest top-probability threshold with at most1% errors on fixed30% tuning claims; frozen evaluation on other70%.
calibration_and_cost.language_model_cost_latency_basis: Two calls per claim, label then probability; both included.
calibration_and_cost.latency_boundary: Gateway measured model latency, excluding sandbox-to-gateway hop.

good_roles: Chunk and rank evidence ONLY inside the provided excerpt.
Hybrid lexical/dense retrieval with explicit entity/date/unit/value relations.
Native RuVector execution and retained provenance for every claim.
Calibrated tri-label decision layer and uncertainty routing.
missing_capabilities_in_current_bge_smal: Reliable semantic entailment and subtle contradiction detection.
Complete8k–16k-token evidence coverage beyond current256token embedding context.
ruvector_fit.critical_guard: A top-k evidence miss is not proof of insufficient_evidence. Scan or cover the entire supplied excerpt and distinguish irrelevant/different-company evidence from contradiction.

access.meaning: No raw dataset, scorer, license or direct submission link appeared in the inspected official page/aggregate. Metadata labels dataset_type public; this does not establish an accessible licensed download.

prerequisites: Obtain verified official item set and evaluation/submission protocol.
Pin dataset revision, license, item identities, exact prompt/options, split and scorer before native calls.
arms: Same decision/NLI model with full supplied excerpt and no RuVector selection
Same decision model with native RuVector within-excerpt retrieval plus lexical/numeric checks
pilot_plan.internal_development: Freeze a separate filing-disjoint development/calibration/confirmation split for own claims; preserve publisher fixedsplit for official report. Do not tune on ten public examples or target errors.
metrics: Accuracy by excerpt length and gold label
Coverage at publisher1%error budget on untouched split
End-to-end p50/p95 and actual cost/claim including native embedding/retrieval
pilot_plan.promotion: No accuracy regression on untouched claims; demonstrate retrieval contribution in matched model/data/budget ablation. Full official score and placement only after publisher evaluation.
